import sys

MOD = 1000000007

def fast_pow(base, pow):
    ans = 1
    while pow:
        if pow & 1:
            ans = (ans * base) % MOD
        base = (base * base) % MOD
        pow >>= 1
    return ans

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    p = int(data[0])
    K = int(data[1])
    
    if K == 0:
        print(fast_pow(p, p - 1))
        return
    elif K == 1:
        print(fast_pow(p, p))
        return
    
    cnt = 0
    vis = [False] * p
    for i in range(p):
        if vis[i]:
            continue
        size = 0
        tmp = i
        while not vis[tmp]:
            size += 1
            vis[tmp] = True
            tmp = (tmp * K) % p
        if size > 1:
            cnt += 1
    print(fast_pow(p, cnt))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
